dataset_label: Held out from our pipeline; prior model exposure unknown.

judge_limits.codeforces: dataset time and memory limits (C++-calibrated) applied as given

evidence_levels.example_passed: passes the public examples shown in the statement
evidence_levels.independent_tests_passed: passes the full hidden test set

reporting.latency: median and p95 per route; stage breakdown; time to checked answer
